breakdown.description: M_n = Σ(N_i M_i^2) / Σ(N_i M_i); use M_n = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i; the setup substitutes the weight-average formula while asking for the number-average molecular weight.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses the incorrect formula M_n = Σ(N_i M_i²) / Σ(N_i M_i), which is the weight-average molecular weight formula. The correct number-average formula is M_n = Σ(N_i M_i) / ΣN_i. The agent repeated the original error from the incomplete prompt instead of correcting it to match the ground truth.
